en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad public square beside a canal with a small bridge in the foreground. The square is bordered by multi‑story classical buildings; the most prominent one in the center has an ornate façade and arched windows, identified as the Exchange (Börsen). People, horse‑drawn vehicles, and early street life are visible. Printed red caption text appears below the image.
